info.title: Suite progetti: AssociaGo / LibrePM / Bandi
info.description: Canonical HTTP boundary. x-suite-systems identifies the applications implementing each operation. Existing local user authentication remains authoritative; peer keys are server-only. Versions are nonnegative integers, monetary values decimal strings. All response properties are present; unavailable summaries are null. No raw member/volunteer data.
